# v0.1.1 assessment fixture

Produced by the original implementation at
`479d79cfd694079685c89a0a4cda8b18e70e6c0c` (the reviewed base, before the
checked-evidence reader): `prepare → freeze → run → assess` over a one-slot
copy of `tests/fixtures/skill-basic`, with an injected image identity and a
text-only fake trial.

It is genuine old-format output: the assessment has no `evaluatorVersion` and
no `evidence` binding, and its ledger event hashes the exact old bytes. Do not
regenerate or rewrite it.
